office: the Public Service Development Agency (territorial offices, Public Service Halls; abroad, Georgia's diplomatic and consular offices)
note: The fees by speed are the adult's; the minors' fees and the under-16 validity aren't on the page (leads). A photo taken at the Agency costs GEL 5.

sources.title: Public Service Development Agency (sda.gov.ge), Passport
sources.said: A passport is issued to an adult for a term of 10 years. To obtain a biometric passport of a citizen of Georgia, apply to any territorial office of the Public Service Development Agency, any branch of the Public Service Hall, and Diplomatic Representation and consular office of Georgia abroad or enjoy an online service. Terms and fees of service On the 10 th working day – GEL 150; On the 5 th working day – GEL 180; On the 3 rd working day – GEL 225; In 24 hours – GEL 300; On the same day – GEL 350 ... A passport is issued to a minor between 16 and 18 years of age for a term of 3 years ... The fee for a biometric passport for an adult is GEL 150 and is issued on the 10 th working
